interface.shortDescription: Modern Discord Bot expertise & security auditing
interface.longDescription: MBD Guidance is an agent skill and zero-dependency CLI tool designed to help AI coding agents build, modernize, and audit Discord bots using modern Discord API v10, discord.js v14.28.1+, Components V2, Serverless HTTP Interactions (Ed25519), and secure Web Dashboard integration rather than outdated v12/v13 workarounds.
defaultPrompt: Audit this Discord bot project for legacy patterns, security boundaries, and architecture issues
Implement a paginated command response using Discord Components V2 and stateful custom IDs
Connect this Next.js web dashboard securely to my Discord bot with OAuth2 guild permissions and IPC sync
